A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same infomorphic-neuron study, with readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A.1–A.11. The mismatched Figure 6 in v1 is an identifiable document difference, not an extraction gap.

before.justification: v1 reports original MNIST and CIFAR10 experiments, including classification performance, parameter ablations, convergence analyses, and preliminary deeper-network results.

after.justification: v3 retains those original experiments and additionally displays the optimization outcomes and parameter-importance maps described in Appendix A.6.

M1.justification: The PID objectives, neuron architectures, activation functions, and local-gradient training procedures in Sections 2–4 and Appendix A.1 are unchanged. Corrected Figure 6 documents outcomes of the existing optimization procedure rather than a method revision.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate MNIST and CIFAR10 classification with the same task coverage. No dataset, domain, or distinct test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The backpropagation, random-projection, readout-only, and bivariate comparisons in Figures 3 and 8 are retained. Both TPE and CMA-ES optimization were already described and compared in v1; correcting Figure 6 does not introduce a comparator.

E3.justification: Data splits, validation procedures, model configurations, training budgets, and discretization settings remain unchanged. The optimization budgets and maximum-validation-accuracy criterion represented in corrected Figure 6 were already specified in v1.

E4.justification: Figure 6 now supplies the optimized-objective comparisons and mean-decrease-impurity importance maps described in Appendix A.6. v1 describes this analysis but displays an unrelated architecture/performance graphic instead. Other ablations, sensitivity tests, and convergence analyses are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions specify ten-run reporting with mean and minimum–maximum intervals in Figures 3–4 and three optimization repetitions per sampler in Appendix A.6. Figure 6 adds visible outcomes without changing run counts or uncertainty-reporting procedures.

E6.justification: Corrected Figure 6 newly displays maximum validation accuracies of 94.7%, 93.9%, and 94.7% for TPE and 95.4%, 94.4%, and 95.4% for CMA-ES, alongside goal-coefficient and importance maps. These replace v1's misplaced graphic; the main benchmark scores remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The PID definitions, objective equations, shared-exclusion formulation, and consistency equations in Sections 2–3 and Appendices A.2 and A.7–A.8 are unchanged. Equation-spacing adjustments do not revise the mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and discussion retain the same claims about interpretable local PID objectives, three input classes, and classification performance comparable to backpropagation. Figure 6 supplies supporting evidence without changing those claims.

C2.justification: The interpretations of important PID atoms, convergence behavior, and applicability limitations are retained. Even Figure 6's explanation for selecting the first TPE objective despite higher CMA-ES maximum validation accuracy is already present in v1.

D1.justification: Corrected Figure 6 makes the alternative optimized goal-coefficient configurations visible, adding limited graphical hyperparameter documentation. The pseudocode, Table 1 training settings, compute-resource disclosures, data-processing details, and code-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and references are unchanged, including positioning relative to bivariate infomorphic networks, coherent infomax, other local-learning approaches, and PID-based network analysis.

P1.justification: The introduction merges paragraphs without changing their wording or scientific meaning. Author affiliation ordering and the contact-information block are updated; the section structure and substantive narrative are retained.

P2.justification: Figure 6 replaces a misplaced network-architecture/performance illustration with a four-column display of optimized goals and parameter importance that matches its caption. Other figures and tables are unchanged, with limited text reflow and equation-spacing adjustments.

improvement.justification: v3 resolves Figure 6's clear mismatch with its caption and supplies the optimization and importance evidence referenced in Section 5 and Appendix A.6. This improves accuracy and makes the supporting analysis inspectable. The main method, experiments, and conclusions remain unchanged, so the overall gain is limited.
